items.title: Labcorp (LH) Launches Marker Genetic Health Panel For Consumer Testing
items.summary: Labcorp Holdings (NYSE:LH) has introduced the Marker by Labcorp Genetic Health Panel, a new consumer-focused genetic testing service. The product brings together genetic testing, counseling, and biomarker analysis in one offering for individuals looking to better understand their health risks. The launch uses Labcorp’s existing testing infrastructure alongside new AI-powered platforms to support more tailored insights for consumers. items.title: LH Q2 Deep Dive: Specialty Testing and Consumer Growth Drive Guidance Increase
items.summary: Healthcare diagnostics company Labcorp Holdings (NYSE:LH) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 5.8% year on year to $3.73 billion. The company’s outlook for the full year was close to analysts’ estimates with revenue guided to $14.77 billion at the midpoint. Its non-GAAP profit of $4.99 per share was 4.6% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
